build_VGG_backbone: build a VGG backbone model with depth 16 for pose estimation feature extraction
create_make_vgg_layer: create a VGG layer with configurable conv blocks, dilation, and max pooling
run_VGG_forward: run the VGG forward pass to extract multi-stage feature maps from input tensor
freeze_VGG_stages: freeze the first N stages of a VGG backbone to prevent gradient updates
review_VGG_arch_settings: review the VGG architecture settings for depths 11, 13, 16, and 19
